name: Damian
source:
"Huh? Say something stupid and I'll punch you."

A short-tempered thug who quickly resorts to violence when angry. He lived a carefree life causing trouble in the city but was jailed for violently assaulting delinquents. A lone wolf who keeps others at a distance, always frowning. His physical abilities are top-notch.
